title: Psychological Strategy Board as source of early alien lore

tellings.quote: He was also Corso um on the psychological strategy board under Eisenhower. So, it was like all military psychological operations were like going it was Gordon Gray and it was this other guy Charles Douglas Jackson and you know Philip Corso and a lot of the early alien lore comes from that nexus of people

plain: Much of the early lore about aliens came out of a small circle of people around the Psychological Strategy Board, a body under President Eisenhower in the 1950s that oversaw military psychological operations. That is how Michels puts it, in his own framing and without naming a source. He says the circle included the officials Gordon Gray and Charles Douglas Jackson, and Philip J. Corso, who he says sat on the board. If he is right, some of the best-known alien stories may have started among people whose job was shaping what the public believed.
